sql: SELECT p.category, p.product_name, SUM(CASE WHEN s.month = '2026-07' THEN s.units ELSE 0 END) AS jul_units, SUM(CASE WHEN s.month = '2026-05' THEN s.units ELSE 0 END) AS may_units FROM kola.erp_sales s JOIN kola.product_catalog p ON s.sku = p.sku WHERE s.city = 'Accra' AND s.channel = 'online' GROUP BY p.category, p.product_name ORDER BY ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN s.month = '2026-07' THEN s.units ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN s.month = '2026-05' THEN s.units ELSE 0 END)) DESC LIMIT 50
